`class GlRenderBridge`<br/>
**Extends:** [`RenderBridge`](/reference/bridges/renderbridge/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.opengl.render` · **Module:** `base-opengl` · **Source:** [GlRenderBridge.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/opengl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/opengl/render/GlRenderBridge.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 2</span> <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

The render bridge of OpenGL, shared by every OpenGL backend, which calls OpenGL through a binding and gives the host its state back.

## Description

Create it with the context of JOID current on the calling thread: it reads the capabilities of the context at once and throws an `IllegalStateException` when there is none, or when the context is too old.
It draws into the framebuffer that was bound when the frame began, and every change it makes to the state goes through its [`GlStateGuard`](/reference/base-opengl/glstateguard/).
